Why the doctor designed the upgrades
Essential already delivers your core treatment. But when the goal is the strongest possible response, these two upgrades give your body more to work with:
Exosomes IV — billions of signaling vesicles that support your body's repair processes system-wide, not just at the treated site.
Hyperbaric oxygen — increases oxygen availability to your tissues after the application, which may support a calmer, more comfortable recovery.
Systemic stem cells — 100M by IV — a full-body regenerative boost layered on top of your targeted treatment.
Cancer-marker screening + functional review — we look at your whole-body health before adding a systemic dose.

Why clients choose us
Characterised cells. Precise delivery. Measured outcomes.
Passage 3-4 — not passage 5Wharton's-jelly cells at passage 3-4, replication 12–14. Much of the market uses passage 5, replication 40. Fewer passages means younger, more potent cells — and you receive a certificate confirming passage 3-4, free of viruses and bacteria.
An operating room, every timePlaced by anesthesiologists under live ultrasound or fluoroscopy — not injected blind in a treatment room. 8,000+ procedures over more than ten years, 0% major adverse effects.
Your whole treatment, one addressTreatment center, operating room and hotel under one roof. On treatment day, you take an elevator — not a taxi.
One price. Zero surprises.Hotel, transfers, consultations and a dedicated coordinator — all handled, all included. Our partner lab follows US FDA and EMA guidelines for producing human cells for therapeutic use.

Terms & Conditions
  1. To confirm the service, a 50% deposit is required. The remaining 50% is paid prior to treatment.
